{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of Education''' was one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] Ministries. It had two mandates; it served as the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government's]] intelligence branch, and was the Alliance's propaganda arm. Despite its name, the Ministry of Education had no hand in actual educational matters amongst the Alliance; that was left to the individual governments.

The intelligence branch was known as [[Civil Intelligence]]. Focusing on passive intelligence-gathering, operatives of Civil Intelligence monitored Imperial broadcasts, [[news-holo]]s and other media. Civil Intelligence maintained liaison officers with the various [[System Intelligence Branch]]es throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to ensure that the Civil Government was kept informed at all times. Civil Intelligence was also responsible for monitoring the Civil Government in case of attempts by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to infiltrate the organization.

The [[Propaganda Bureau/Legends|Propaganda Bureau]] was responsible for presenting the true face of the Alliance to the citizens of the galaxy. Countering Imperial propaganda was the Bureau's main responsibility, as well as disseminating 20,000 [[Hologram disc/Legends|holo-tapes]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] over [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
